strongest_scoped_result: For a closed oriented 3-manifold with a branched special n-vertex shadow in the Ishikawa-Koda construction, minimum slope at least 2*pi*sqrt(3*n/2) forces ordinary, branched, and stable-map complexities all equal n. Exact stricter threshold also given. This is a credited algebraic consequence, not an unrestricted theorem.
